en.headline: Water supply suspended overnight in Tuen Mun estates after main leak
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department arranged a temporary suspension from 11pm on Tuesday for repairs after a 600mm fresh water main leaked at a construction site near Fu Fat Lane, affecting about 7,000 residents.
body: The Water Supplies Department said a fresh water main with a diameter of 600 millimetres leaked inside a construction site on Castle Peak Road near Fu Fat Lane in Tuen Mun on Tuesday afternoon. The pipe supplies Yi Fung Garden, Hin Fat Estate, Hang Shun Garden, Kwan Fung Garden and Tuen Mun Government Secondary School.

To minimise disruption during peak hours, the department arranged for the water supply to be suspended from 11pm on Tuesday for emergency repairs, aiming to restore service by noon on Wednesday. About 7,000 people were affected.

Temporary water tanks were placed near the affected buildings and notices were issued to management offices. The department coordinated with the Tuen Mun District Office, Housing Department and local representatives to provide support.

zh.headline: 屯門富發里水管滲漏 多個屋苑昨晚11時起停水維修
zh.dek: 水務署安排星期二晚上11時起暫停食水供應進行搶修，受影響包括怡峰園、顯發邨等約7,000人，爭取星期三中午前恢復。
body: 水務署表示，星期二下午接獲報告，指屯門青山公路近富發里一個地盤內有直徑600毫米食水喉滲漏，該喉管供應食水予怡峰園、顯發邨、恆順園、冠峰園及屯門官立中學。
為減少對居民影響，署方安排晚上11時後停水進行緊急維修，目標於星期三中午12時前完成修復並恢復供水，受影響約7,000人。
署方已在受影響大廈附近放置臨時水箱，並向屋苑管理處發出停水通告，同時與屯門民政處、房屋署及區議員緊密聯繫提供支援。
